system: You are a due-diligence document reader on a deal team. Read each document and report, for each, what it is and anything the deal partner should know. Be concise and helpful.

exchanges.user:
Documents:
--- M01 (NDA) ---
Mutual NDA between Northwind Tech and the Buyer, 1 Aug 2026. Standard 3-year mutual confidentiality, NSW law. Nothing unusual.

--- M02 (Lease) ---
Office lease, Level 4, 20 Harbour St. 5-year term from 2024, market rent, standard make-good. No change-of-control clause.

--- M03 (Management accounts - revenue) ---
FY26 management accounts, revenue note: Topaz Retail represents approximately 35% of FY26 revenue. The Topaz master agreement is up for renewal in Q1 FY27; renewal is described as 'under discussion'.

--- M04 (HR) ---
Employee handbook and leave policy. Standard terms. Headcount 68. Two senior engineers on 6-month notice.

--- M05 (Bank facility) ---
Working-capital facility of AUD 6.0m. Financial covenant: net debt / EBITDA must not exceed 3.0x, tested quarterly. The FY26 Q4 compliance certificate records headroom has narrowed to 2.8x.

--- M06 (IP) ---
Schedule of registered trademarks and two granted software patents, assigned to Northwind Tech. No encumbrances. Open-source policy attached.

--- M07 (Cash flow statement) ---
FY26 statement of cash flows: operating cash flow was negative in two of the last three quarters. Closing cash balance AUD 0.9m.

--- M08 (Insurance) ---
Certificates of currency for public liability, professional indemnity (AUD 5m) and cyber. All current.

--- M09 (Supplier) ---
Note from primary cloud/infrastructure supplier: with effect from last month the supplier moved Northwind from 30-day payment terms to prepayment, citing recent payment history.

--- M10 (Board minutes) ---
Board minutes, Oct 2026: the Board deferred approval of the audited FY26 accounts pending completion of refinancing discussions with two lenders; management expects to conclude 'in the coming weeks'.

--- M11 (Litigation) ---
Reseller claim status note: external counsel's preliminary and non-binding view - which the company disputes and which has not been tested in discovery - is that the matter might resolve somewhere between AUD 0.2m and AUD 2.1m, with the outcome highly uncertain. No provision has been recognised in the accounts.

--- M12 (Policy) ---
Marketing and brand-use policy. Internal guidelines on logo usage and social media. Routine.

--- M13 (Vendor contract) ---
Minor SaaS vendor contract (helpdesk tool), AUD 18k/year, 12-month term, auto-renew with 30-day opt-out. Routine.

--- M14 (Policy) ---
Data-retention and records policy. Standard retention schedule. Routine.

--- M15 (Fixed assets) ---
Fixed-asset register: laptops, office equipment, leasehold improvements. Net book value AUD 0.3m. Routine.

Write your per-document notes.
exchanges.text:
### Document notes

| ID | What it is | Deal-partner takeaways |
|---|---|---|
| **M01** | Mutual NDA between Northwind Tech and the buyer, dated 1 Aug 2026. | Standard three-year mutual confidentiality obligations under NSW law; nothing unusual noted. |
| **M02** | Five-year office lease for Level 4, 20 Harbour St, beginning in 2024. | Market rent and standard make-good. No change-of-control clause reported. |
| **M03** | FY26 management-account revenue note. | Topaz Retail is approximately **35% of FY26 revenue**; its master agreement is due for renewal in Q1 FY27, with renewal still “under discussion.” Material customer concentration and near-term renewal risk. |
| **M04** | Employee handbook and leave policy. | Standard terms; headcount is 68. Two senior engineers have six-month notice periods, relevant to retention and transition planning. |
| **M05** | AUD 6.0m working-capital facility and covenant certificate. | Net debt/EBITDA must not exceed 3.0x, tested quarterly. FY26 Q4 headroom has narrowed to **2.8x**—limited remaining covenant cushion; confirm current compliance and lender discussions. |
| **M06** | IP schedule, including registered trademarks, two granted software patents, and an open-source policy. | IP is stated to be assigned to Northwind Tech with no encumbrances. Verify underlying assignments and any open-source compliance exposure in diligence. |
| **M07** | FY26 statement of cash flows. | Operating cash flow was negative in two of the last three quarters; closing cash was **AUD 0.9m**. Liquidity and cash-generation are key diligence points. |
| **M08** | Certificates of currency for public liability, professional indemnity, and cyber insurance. | Cover is current; professional indemnity limit is **AUD 5m**. Confirm limits and policy terms are adequate for the business and any identified exposures. |
| **M09** | Notice from primary cloud/infrastructure supplier. | Supplier moved Northwind from 30-day terms to **prepayment**, citing recent payment history. Signals possible payment stress and may increase working-capital needs; confirm scope, timing, and continuity implications. |
| **M10** | October 2026 board minutes. | Board deferred approval of audited FY26 accounts pending refinancing discussions with two lenders; management expects a conclusion “in the coming weeks.” Important financing and reporting uncertainty. Confirm refinancing status and whether audited accounts have since been approved. |
| **M11** | Reseller litigation status note. | Counsel’s preliminary, non-binding and untested view suggests a possible resolution range of **AUD 0.2m–2.1m**; the company disputes the claim and no provision is recorded. Outcome is highly uncertain; seek updated counsel advice and assess accounting and transaction exposure. |
| **M12** | Marketing and brand-use policy. | Routine internal guidance on logo use and social media; no issue flagged. |
| **M13** | Minor SaaS helpdesk contract, AUD 18k/year. | 12-month term with automatic renewal and 30-day opt-out. Low-value; track the opt-out deadline if termination is desired. |
| **M14** | Data-retention and records policy. | Standard retention schedule; no issue flagged. |
| **M15** | Fixed-asset register. | Laptops, office equipment, and leasehold improvements with net book value of **AUD 0.3m**. Routine; confirm existence and condition as appropriate. |
